findings: An extension has one or more pragmas and an optional associated expression, at ValueExpr precedence.
Pragma names are EQNames; prefixed names use static namespace resolution (XPST0081); unprefixed/no-namespace pragmas are ignored in 3.1.
Unrecognized namespaces are ignored. When all pragmas are ignored, evaluate the associated expression; if absent, XQST0079.

Pragma contents are raw characters ending at the first #); ordinary comment or string-literal processing is inappropriate inside contents. Required whitespace separates the name from nonempty contents.

Recognized namespaces and behavior are implementation-defined. Invalid recognized content raises XQST0013; static errors in associated expressions must still be reported. No recognized pragma namespace is proposed here.
An implementation slice needs explicit namespace policy, raw lexer support, fallback/static errors, and precedence before routing admission.
